name: bandit.phase4_structural_signal_matrix_live_mcw
description: Phase-4 live smoke/light/sound matrix plus a comfort-first ecology-observer incident on one production-owned schema-10 structural sortie. The derived handoff fixture preserves the same signal footing and adds only DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE. An idle five-member camp autonomously dispatches its exact pair toward source-proved terrain-opportunity road target (137,49,0), approaches through (139,51,0), and watches from (138,52,0). The passive player at abs_ms (3336,1187,0) keeps the target and return route in loaded reality while the watch remains out of bounds; scenario setup places one real active explosive and one physical fire 36 map squares west on the target. Production must retain three typed target-to-watch facts and create exactly three returned_report leads only after physical return.

evidence_contract.claim: one autonomous schema-10 abstract scout pair reaches its selected watch, reads physical smoke, light, and a semantic explosion from the committed target footprint, appears in a same-run natural ecology-observer screenshot/incident pair before return, retains typed facts without creating camp knowledge early, and creates exactly three bounded returned_report leads only after physical return
evidence_contract.setup_boundary: passive debug-cloaked player relocation, the source-proved road lead, one physical fire, and one real SPAWN_ACTIVE explosive are fixture/scenario footing; the derived observer child adds only DEBUG_CLAIRVOYANCE and its transform report must name that mutation; no typed observation, signal lead, target footprint, watch selection, route position, camp report, or return is injected
evidence_contract.load_only_verdict: load/setup proof only / inconclusive for the structural signal matrix
evidence_contract.observer_artifact_requirement: The same harness run must contain a natural-provenance ecology_incident JSON and its atomic PNG pair plus the selected-dispatch overmap capture. File payload and pairing verification is coordinator artifact inspection, not a new harness parser.
evidence_contract.failure_rule: No Phase-4 matrix credit unless exact dispatch and approach clocks, target-loaded/watch-abstract geometry, the exact minute-10080 target-footprint-to-watch smoke/light/explosion observations, pre-return no-lead state, the same-run natural observer screenshot/incident pair, physical return, and three exact persisted returned-report leads are separately green.
